description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between perplexity and quantization bits for two methods, labeled “Uniform” and “Ours”. The horizontal axis represents quantization bits, with categories labeled 3, 4, 8, and 16, arranged in ascending order. The vertical axis represents perplexity, labeled as “Perplexity”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30 in chart (a), 0 to 400 in chart (b), and 0 to 30 in chart (c), with tick marks at intervals of 5, 50, and 5 respectively. Each chart contains paired bars for each quantization bit value, representing the “Uniform” method in blue and the “Ours” method in orange. In chart (a), the “Uniform” bars range in height from approximately 15 to 27, while the “Ours” bars range from approximately 8 to 22. In chart (b), the “Uniform” bars range in height from approximately 170 to 320, while the “Ours” bars range from approximately 90 to 160. In chart (c), the “Uniform” bars range in height from approximately 10 to 25, while the “Ours” bars range from approximately 6 to 18. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each quantization bit value, allowing for a visual comparison of perplexity between the two methods at each level of quantization. No bars are visually emphasized.
